title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19840 an HTML injection in email notifications was possible via issue descriptions…
description: An HTML injection vulnerability exists in JetBrains YouTrack versions prior to 2026.2.19840. This flaw allows injection of HTML content in email notifications via issue descriptions. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating and can impact confidentiality and integrity but does not affect availability.
